description: Genehmigungsbedürftige Anlagen nach BImSchG im Freistaat Sachsen (ohne Windkraft, Biogas und Tierhaltung) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Data on installations requiring authorisation in accordance with 4. BImSchV without wind power, biogas and animal husbandry plants. A distinction is made, inter alia, between categories 1-10 of the 4. BImSchV and whether the installations are affected by Directive 2010/75/EU or not. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Installations requiring approval according to BImSchG in the Free State of Saxony (excluding wind power, biogas and anim" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Deutschland, 2010/75/EU, Produktions- und Industrieanlagen, Freistaat Sachsen, opendata, BImSchG (Bundesimmissionsschutzgesetz). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
